title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at sixty-four thousand eight hundred thirty-three dollars, up zero point three percent, as fear and greed sits at twenty-nine. High hashrate of seven hundred ninety-four exahashes shows miners undeterred while the mempool clears eighty-four thousand transactions at just two satoshis per vbyte. Block height reaches nine hundred sixty-one thousand four hundred fourteen. Asia session brought quiet consolidation overnight. Watch for any sentiment shift that could test resistance above
